info.title: meeng.dev API
info.description: The meeng.dev e-mail API: send e-mails, manage domains, contacts, campaigns, templates, suppressions, webhooks and analytics. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer mg_<clientId>_<token>`.

get.description: Time series of the e-mail the team sent, transactional and marketing together, with each day's counters. A day with nothing is all zeros. The day is the UTC one, labeled as "Nov 20".

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days back to count: 7 or 30 (default 30). The answer has one entry for each of those days and one for today.

parameters.name: domainId
parameters.description: Count only this domain, by its numeric id. A value that is not a number filters nothing. A key restricted to one domain reads that domain and ignores this.

400.description: days is not 7 or 30.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: What was delivered, hard-bounced and complained about since the beginning, and the two rates in percent, not rounded: hardBounced over delivered, and complained over delivered, zero when nothing was delivered.

parameters.name: domainId
parameters.description: Read only this domain, by its numeric id. A value that is not a number filters nothing. A key restricted to one domain reads that domain and ignores this.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: Campaigns newest first, 30 to a page. A key restricted to one domain sees the campaigns that send from it.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page, from 1; 30 campaigns to a page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only campaigns in this status.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the name or of the subject.

400.description: The status is not one of the five, or the page is not a number.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Makes a draft campaign for a contact book. Either content (the editor's document) or html is required, and the message must carry the unsubscribe link, {{meeng_unsubscribe_url}}. With sendNow, or with scheduledAt (ISO 8601, or words such as 'tomorrow 9am'), it is scheduled at once; when the scheduling is refused the draft stays made and the answer is the refusal.

400.description: The body is not valid, the book or the sender is wrong, or the unsubscribe link is missing (BAD_REQUEST).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: One campaign of the team, with its counters.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The ID of the campaign.

404.description: Campaign not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

delete.description: Deletes the campaign, even one that is running. The e-mails it already made stay. The answer is the whole row that was deleted.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The ID of the campaign.

404.description: Campaign not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Stops the campaign between batches. It does not look at the status it is in.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The ID of the campaign.

404.description: Campaign not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Lets a paused campaign go on: scheduled when its date is still ahead, running otherwise.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The ID of the campaign.

404.description: Campaign not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Puts the campaign in line: now when scheduledAt is not given, or at the date (ISO 8601, or words such as 'tomorrow 9am'). It is refused when the campaign has no book, no content, no unsubscribe link or no subscribed contact.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: The ID of the campaign.

400.description: The body is not valid, or the campaign cannot be scheduled (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: Campaign not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: Every contact book of the team, each with the number of contacts it holds, in no particular order.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Makes a contact book with double opt-in on and the default confirmation e-mail, then applies what the body says. A confirmation e-mail has to contain the {{doubleOptInUrl}} placeholder. On the free plan the team has one book; past it the answer is 403 FORBIDDEN with the message CONTACT_BOOK.

400.description: The body is not valid, or the sender or the confirmation content is refused (BAD_REQUEST).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: One contact book with its contact count.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

404.description: Contact book not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

delete.description: Deletes the book and its contacts. Campaigns that pointed at it keep existing with no book.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

patch.description: Changes the fields the body carries and leaves the others as they are.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

400.description: The body is not valid (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.summary: List the contacts of a contact book
get.description: The contacts of the book, in id order, as an array with no total.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

parameters.name: emails
parameters.description: Comma separated e-mail addresses; an exact match.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page, from 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Contacts to a page; 5000 when it is not given.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated contact ids.

400.description: A number in the query is not a number.

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.summary: Add a contact to a contact book
post.description: Creates the contact, or updates the one with that e-mail. A contact that left stays out (only PATCH subscribes it again). When the book has double opt-in on, a new contact is pending, not subscribed, until it confirms the e-mail that is sent to it.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

400.description: The body is not valid (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.summary: Add contacts to a contact book in bulk
post.description: Takes up to 1000 contacts and adds them in the background, one by one, as POST of a contact does. The answer is how many were taken; a contact that cannot be added is not reported.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

400.description: The body is not valid, or has more than 1000 contacts.

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

delete.summary: Delete contacts of a contact book in bulk
delete.description: Deletes the contacts of the book that the ids name, from 1 to 1000. Ids that are not in the book are ignored.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

400.description: The body is not valid, or has more than 1000 ids.

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact.

404.description: Contact not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

put.description: Does what POST of a contact does. The contactId of the path is not read: the contact is found, or made, by its e-mail.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact.

400.description: The body is not valid (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: Contact book not found for this team (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

delete.description: Deletes the contact from the book.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact.

404.description: Contact not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

patch.description: Changes the fields the body carries. Properties are merged over the old ones. This is the call that subscribes a contact again, with subscribed true.

parameters.name: contactBookId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact book.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The ID of the contact.

400.description: The body is not valid (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: Contact not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: The domains of the team the key belongs to, newest first, each with the DNS records it must publish. A key restricted to one domain sees that domain alone.

200.description: Retrieve domains accessible by the API key

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Makes the domain, its DKIM key and the records to publish. A key restricted to one domain cannot create another (403).

400.description: The body is not valid: name and region are required text.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: One domain of the team. While it is verifying, the read checks its DNS first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the domain.

400.description: The id is not a number.

404.description: A key restricted to another domain (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

delete.description: Deletes the domain and the API keys restricted to it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the domain.

400.description: The id is not a number.

404.description: Domain not found (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

put.description: Starts the verification of the domain's DNS records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the domain.

400.description: The id is not a number.

404.description: Domain not found, or the key is restricted to another one.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: The team's e-mails, newest first, a page of at most 50 and the total of the same filter. A key restricted to a domain lists that domain's e-mails and ignores domainId. With both dates only endDate counts, as in the reference.

400.description: A date is not an ISO 8601 date-time in UTC.

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Accepts an e-mail and queues it. The sender's domain must be one of the team's and verified. A template (templateId and variables) replaces subject and html. When every recipient of `to` is on the suppression list the e-mail is recorded as SUPPRESSED and the answer is still 200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Pass the optional Idempotency-Key header to make the request safe to retry. The key can be up to 256 characters. The server stores the canonical request body and behaves as follows: the same key with the same body returns the original ids with 200 OK without sending again; the same key with a different body returns 409 NOT_UNIQUE; the same key while another request is still running returns 409 NOT_UNIQUE, retry after a short delay. Entries expire after 24 hours.

templateId.description: ID of a template from the dashboard.

variables.description: The values of the template's variables, as text.

headers.description: Custom headers to include with the e-mail, name to value.

400.description: The body or a parameter is not valid (ZodError), or the request is refused (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: The e-mail or the template is not the team's (NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The Idempotency-Key is taken by another body or by a request still running (NOT_UNIQUE).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.summary: Send up to 100 e-mails in one call
post.description: Every e-mail is validated before any is written, and all are written together: either all are accepted, in the order they came, or none is.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Pass the optional Idempotency-Key header to make the request safe to retry. The key can be up to 256 characters. The server stores the canonical request body and behaves as follows: the same key with the same body returns the original ids with 200 OK without sending again; the same key with a different body returns 409 NOT_UNIQUE; the same key while another request is still running returns 409 NOT_UNIQUE, retry after a short delay. Entries expire after 24 hours.

templateId.description: ID of a template from the dashboard.

variables.description: The values of the template's variables, as text.

headers.description: Custom headers to include with the e-mail, name to value.

200.description: List of the ids of the accepted e-mails

400.description: The body or a parameter is not valid (ZodError), or the request is refused (BAD_REQUEST).

404.description: The e-mail or the template is not the team's (NOT_FOUND).

409.description: The Idempotency-Key is taken by another body or by a request still running (NOT_UNIQUE).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

get.description: One e-mail of the team with its events.

parameters.name: emailId
parameters.description: The ID of the e-mail.

400.description: The id has fewer than three characters.

404.description: The e-mail is not the team's, or not of the key's domain (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

patch.description: Moves a scheduled e-mail to another time, an ISO 8601 date-time in UTC. Only an e-mail still SCHEDULED can be moved (400 "Email already processed").

parameters.name: emailId
parameters.description: The ID of the e-mail.

400.description: The body is not valid, or the e-mail was already processed.

404.description: The e-mail is not the team's, or not of the key's domain (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

post.description: Cancels an e-mail that is still SCHEDULED (400 "Email already processed" otherwise).

parameters.name: emailId
parameters.description: The ID of the e-mail.

400.description: The id is not valid, or the e-mail was already processed.

404.description: The e-mail is not the team's, or not of the key's domain (NOT_FOUND).

429.description: Over the team's requests per second (RATE_LIMITED); wait for Retry-After.

Bearer.bearerFormat: API key of the team, mg_<clientId>_<token>, made in Developer settings.
